notes.title: Rebuilding Momentum
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,
it's been a while since our journey began, and I wanted to take a moment to fill you in on the happenings and extend a heartfelt apology. [b]As a solo developer, I underestimated the challenges of a commercial release[/b]. Mistakes were made: from the initial price point to the quality assurance process, and I'm here to make things right. I've teamed up with the passionate folks at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/gamerainteractive]Gamera Interactive[/url], fellow indie developers who've provided insights and support. 

The price has been a point of contention, and I've reevaluated it. After careful consideration and feedback from the community, [b]Brinefall will now be available at a new price point of 7.99€/$[/b]. This adjustment brings it in line with other games of similar scope. Furthermore, I want to ensure that this adjustment is fair for all our players around the world. As a result, the price will be slightly adjusted depending on your country to account for regional economic factors. Rest assured, this change is aimed at making Brinfall accessible to a wider audience, and I appreciate your understanding.

Due to recent developments, including the development of a new project, I've considered the possibility of transitioning Brinefall to a new engine. This, however, would take considerabIe time away from the game's development. [b]After careful consideration, I've decided to stay with Unity for Brinefall's continued journey[/b]. Rest assured, I'm committed to providing the best experience possible within this framework.

In response to the valuable feedback from the community, this update focuses on polishing and addressing various issues that have been brought to my attention. I've listened, and I'm committed to making Brinefall the best it can be. [b]You can expect smoother gameplay, enhanced performances, and a more immersive experience overall[/b]. I've also tackled bugs and glitches reported by the community. 

Thank you for your patience and unwavering support. Keep an eye out for the upcoming updates, and let's embark on this journey anew.

Michael

[h3]CHANGELOG[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game is now way more balanced [tweaked numbers and values].
[*] Added Steam integration and 21 achievements.
[*] Camera behavior improved.
[*] Performance improvements for potato hardware.
[*] Fixed bleeding effect
[*] Fixed the roof alignment, not working properly
[*] Fixed audio issues [volumes, missing SFX, added new music per biome].
[*] The scout can now bring back the boat to town
[*] Fixed the Setting menu not always working properly
[*] Fixed Quality Settings
[*] Various fixes on UI
[*] AI general improvements added
[/list]

notes.title: Post launch improvements round-up and a new update on the way!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I hope this message finds you well! First and foremost, I want to extend my deepest apologies for the silence on my end lately. I've been nose to the grindstone at work, striving to bring you the best experience possible. Since the release, [b]I've been tirelessly working on a series of updates to enhance Brinefall and your gaming experience[/b]. From performance tweaks to user interface refinements, every effort has been made to ensure that you get the most out of the game.

[b]I'm thrilled to let you know that a new content update is on the horizon![/b] This one's packed with exciting improvements that I'm sure you'll love. Your feedback has been invaluable, and I've taken every suggestion to heart. 

[b]As a solo developer, this journey has been a rollercoaster of challenges and triumphs[/b]. But let me assure you, my passion for this project burns brighter than ever. Your support means the world to me, and I'm committed to delivering an experience worth your support!

Thank you for your patience, and stay tuned for more updates. That's an overview of the fixes already available in-game i've released from launch on.

I want to take a minute to thank everyone once again for the feedback and feel free, to be honest. I'm doing this game for the player and not for me. Your feedback helps me a lot to improve the game! 

Have fun, everyone!

notes.title: Brinefall is out!
notes.content:
After 3 years of work, I'm proud to finally release it!

The day has finally arrived! I'm thrilled to announce that Brinfall is now officially available on Steam. This is a momentous occasion, marking the culmination of countless hours, endless dedication, and a whole lot of heart. Brinefall invites you into a world of magic, mystery, and epic quests. From the enchanting landscapes to the pulse-pounding battles, every pixel of this game has been crafted with passion and care. I'm so excited for you to embark on this adventure.

As a solo developer, I poured my heart and soul into this game and I am proud to share it with you all. I hope you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed creating it. 

This journey would not have been possible without the unwavering support and patience of this incredible community. Your feedback, your encouragement, and your belief in Brinefall have been the driving force behind this project.

To celebrate this release, we have a special launch discount in place! For a limited time, you can embark on this extraordinary adventure at a special price.

Thank you, each and every one of you, for being a part of this incredible journey. Now, it's time to dive into the world of Brinefall. Let the quest begin!

Warm regards,
Michael

notes.title: Massive update for December
notes.content:
[h1]New combat system, building, per weapon abilities, quests, and more![/h1]

Many of you filled out the feedback form and we listened. 

[h2]New combat system[/h2]
Faster and more instinctive combat system, including area of effect on the ground, dodge, and per weapon abilities.

[h2]Better building system[/h2]
New UI for the building system, more instinctive and faster. New ways to learn recipes as you progress in the game and tons of bugs fixed.

[h2]New game UI[/h2]
Complete overhaul of the UI of the game to fit more with Brinefall in general.

[h2]Progression[/h2]
Small quest systems to guide you through the demo from the beginning to the end of it.

[h2]And much more...[/h2]
Better performance, removed lag spikes, more fluidity in the game, and much more.

The core is done and Brinefall is slowly progressing toward its release early next year.
Thank you everyone for the feedback and feel free to provide more in the future!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716600/Brinefall/

notes.title: Huge combat, building overhaul and changes to come!
notes.content:
Since the release of the demo, I have received more than a hundred feedback and it really helped to shape the future of Brinefall. Thank you!

I wanted to take a moment to keep you informed of what comes with the next massive update.

[b]Combat overhaul[/b]
The combat system will be greatly improved with weapon abilities, enemies's attacks can now be avoided and not indicate their next move.
The controls are also revamped for a better feeling.

[b]Better building system[/b]
Many bugs have been fixed, the control is improved and the recipes will be learnable.

[b]And much more![/b]
Improved quest system, invasions, bosses, better audio, and elites to fight.

The example above is just to name a few but I wanted to take the time to inform you about the development and tell you that the feedback was really useful to pinpoint what needed to be done. I will still need some time before I can release the update but I can't wait to share it and get your feedback!

notes.title: The demo of Brinefall is now live!
notes.content:
Today is a huge milestone!

I am elated to announce a significant milestone in our journey together. The demo of Brinefall is now available for you to explore on Steam! This is an opportunity for you to step into a world of magic, intrigue, and grand quests.

Within this limited preview, you will find yourself amidst awe-inspiring landscapes, facing off against formidable adversaries, and delving into the well-guarded secrets of Brinfall's mystical realm. It's a tantalizing glimpse into the sprawling adventure that awaits you.

Your participation in this demo is not just a chance to play; it's an invitation to influence the future of Brinefall. Your feedback, insights, and suggestions will be invaluable in refining and perfecting this game into an experience that surpasses all expectations.

I'm beyond excited to share this moment with you. The download is now available, and I can't wait for you to embark on this journey alongside me. I will also be very active in the next few days on the forum, feel free to provide any feedback you have (both good and bad). I want to know what you think of it and this will influence the content of the upcoming release.
